Subject: Your Sigma 18-35 rental deposit

Hi Aoife,

Thank you for returning the Sigma 18-35. I'm sorry to write about your deposit, because I know a deduction is never welcome news.

When the lens came back, the front element had a scratch. We kept $160 of your $600 deposit to cover it. We believe that's fair, since a scratch on the front element is damage beyond normal wear and tear. I understand this may be frustrating, especially if you hadn't noticed it happen.

If it would help, we can send you photos of the scratch so you can see it for yourself.

We'd also like to meet you partway. We can lower the charge to $100 and refund the $60 difference to you, if you'd prefer that.

How would you like to proceed? Tell us whether you'd like the photos, the reduced charge, or to talk it through, and we'll take it from there.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
